scope: Read-only source inspection and temporary reconstruction of an existing 1858-row partial warm cache. This predates the full feature-release helper test and is not a full-cache export, benchmark result, or independent alignment verification.

npz_roundtrip.method: Remove only the narration array; regenerate it by UID from selected rows with the original dtype; write arrays in original NPZ member order with numpy.savez_compressed.

json_roundtrip.method: Preserve key order and all other values; replace each row_coverage.tokens/oov_tokens with null. Restore tokens using the frozen tokenizer and UID-linked selected narration, and restore OOV lists using the aggregate OOV vocabulary. Write json.dumps(indent=2) plus newline.

limitations: This is a bounded partial-cache proof. Production export must separately check every row of the frozen 9392-row sample and pass its own exact roundtrip.
Byte identity was proved with this Python/NumPy/zlib stack, original array order and narration dtype. Other writer versions can preserve array values while changing ZIP bytes.

The restored full NPZ and JSON must match their original hashes before the unchanged frozen result verifier is allowed to consume them. Failure to match is a failed restoration, not a benchmark result.
